C_fod_eric.name: Sir Eric
C_fod_eric.role: Knight employed in mundane operations; former hero
C_fod_eric.visual: Small, slim, scruffy human knight; tousled auburn hair tied loosely behind, stubble, long nose, heavy-lidded eyes, low-drama expression. Noticeably smaller than Hork. Distinctive original silhouette in simple cartoon strip proportions.

C_fod_hork.name: Hork
C_fod_hork.visual: Towering, exceptionally large and broad olive-green orc, big square jaw, large tusks, short dark messy hair, small hoop earring, sleepy eyes, heavy limbs; much bigger than Sir Eric.

C_fod_smugesh.name: Smugesh (Kevin)
C_fod_smugesh.visual: Large expressive red-scaled dragon with long angular snout, swept gold horns, yellow heavy-lidded eyes, small wings and imposing claws. Visibly much larger than office workers.

C_fod_grov.name: Grovlizar (Grov)
C_fod_grov.visual: Gaunt pale hooded necromancer with very long hooked nose, narrowed droopy eyes, angular chin and slender hands; readable deadpan silhouette.

C_fod_burz.name: Burz
C_fod_burz.visual: Tiny yellow-green goblin with big pointed ears, small sharp nose, buck teeth, short messy hair and huge round office glasses.

C_fod_murray.name: Murray
C_fod_murray.visual: Older whimsical wizard with wispy white beard, crooked nose and oversized rounded thick spectacles, visually distinct from angular necromancer Grov.

C_fod_sweeps.name: Sweeps
C_fod_sweeps.role: Low-level orc minion in facilities maintenance
C_fod_sweeps.visual: Short stocky green orc minion; small tusks, scowling sleepy expression, distinct rounded glasses with very thick coke-bottle lenses; hood rather than hat. Far smaller than Hork.

C_fod_fodder.name: Fodder
C_fod_fodder.visual: Generic slight human skeleton wearing a battered iron helmet with a simple dent, ordinary bones and basic rusted guard kit; not a unique superhero or ornate undead officer.

C_fod_dark_lord.name: The Dark Lord
C_fod_dark_lord.visual: Tall imposing black-armored dark lord, spiked crown-like helmet, narrow glowing yellow eyes in deep shadow, severe straight silhouette, dark cape.

C_fod_head_demon.name: The Head Demon
C_fod_head_demon.visual: No approved bodily design. Represent through distant black communication crystals, sealed directives, monumental shadows or off-panel speech. Do not fabricate a physical character appearance.

C_fod_lady_raindew.name: Lady Raindew
C_fod_lady_raindew.role: Elf leader and competing good faction liaison
C_fod_lady_raindew.visual: Tall elegant blonde elf with long pale hair, pointed ears, narrow calm eyes and graceful clean lines.

C_fod_elf_prisoner.name: Elf prisoner
C_fod_elf_prisoner.visual: Adult slim light-haired elf with pointed ears, worn travel clothing and clearly visible iron shackles; anonymous role not Lady Raindew.

C_fod_orc_attendant.name: Orc dungeon attendant
C_fod_orc_attendant.visual: Large but not Hork-sized institutional orc in drab brown work uniform with badge, keyring and clipboard; deadpan polite professional cruelty.

C_fod_hero.name: Rescuing hero
C_fod_hero.visual: Generic gallant fantasy rescuer with practical polished armor and colorful cloth, separate from Sir Eric.

C_fod_villager.name: Villager
C_fod_villager.role: Unidentified civilian affected by occupations and curses
C_fod_villager.visual: Ordinary human adult villager in worn practical rural clothing; expressive but not caricatured.

fortress-office.name: Fortress Corporate Offices
fortress-office.text: Lived-in medieval fortress converted to normal corporate work: stone vaults, arched windows, eye-emblem maroon banners, paper files, desk calendars, mugs, torches and practical workstations. The raids and dungeons remain visible beyond office windows.

war-room.name: Post-Battle Conference Room
war-room.text: Large stone-walled war-room with long meeting table, campaign maps, attendance records, enchanted projection maps and consequences of military loss in view.

wizard-lab.name: Wizard Research Department
wizard-lab.text: Stone-arched magical research office with one clear work surface and a few recognizable research details. Keep background shelves sparse and subdued. Only the current strip's story-required prototypes, cursed products, vials, spell displays or paperwork should appear prominently; do not populate tables with incidental magical clutter.

dungeon-transport.name: Dungeon Transfer Authority
dungeon-transport.text: Evil fortress prison transfer lobby with barred cell doors, visible cell numbers, chained captives, clipboard-carrying orc attendants, grim airline-style queues and departure notices.

dungeon.name: Dungeon Operations
dungeon.text: Real working prison inside a fortress: iron cells, hostile traps, chains, shackles, torchlight, guard posts and prisoner movement.

treasure-vault.name: Dragon Hoard and Company Vault
treasure-vault.text: Mountain of gold and jewels mixed with labeled payroll chests, financial records and disputed company assets in a vaulted treasury.

fortress-yard.name: Fortress Military Courtyard
fortress-yard.text: Working evil army base with large company banners, returning wounded troops, siege gear, training yards, smoke and pallets of raiding supplies.

supply-yard.name: Raid Logistics Depot
supply-yard.text: Stone-and-timber supply depot with wagons, crates, relief packages, assigned targets and marching soldiers; raiding and aid share the same warehouse.

elven-front.name: Elven Defensive Frontier
elven-front.text: A competent and beautiful elven border fortress built of sturdy pale stone and forest timbers; clear contrast to the scorched evil army camp.

training-room.name: Workplace Training and HR Room
training-room.text: Stone fortress classroom with mundane meeting table, flip-board, elf and orc attendees, enchanted office presentation and company banners.

breakroom.name: Fortress Employee Breakroom
breakroom.text: Ordinary lived-in breakroom in stone fortress: mugs, pastries, coffee urn, battered table, meal storage, maroon company banner and visible troop traffic.

facilities.name: Fortress Facilities Corridor
facilities.text: Aged stone corridor with arched halls, plumbing, dripping moat water, repairs in progress, cleaning carts, torches and a maintenance worker's tools.

accounting.name: Accounting and HR Office
accounting.text: Stuffy stone fortress office with ledgers, thick binders, financial notices, skeleton workers at desks, clerical equipment and necromancy implements.

ominous-hole.name: Ominous Hole Outpost
ominous-hole.text: Stone-ringed bottomless-looking dark hole in a desolate fortress outpost, simple rope barrier and maroon eye-symbol banners; no confirmed creature inside.

elven-village.name: Occupied Villages
elven-village.text: Human and elven villages with ordinary inhabitants, reconstruction labor, fields, market squares, damage from raids and company soldiers occupying nearby streets.

dark-lord-office.name: Regional Executive Chamber
dark-lord-office.text: Severe imposing executive throne-room with strategic battle maps, ranked banners, controlled lighting, imperial records and evidence of ongoing conquest.

F_fod_company.name: The Forces of Darkness, LLC.
F_fod_company.text: Actual evil corporate empire operating raids, occupation, imprisonment, tribute, curses, weather control, necromancy, monster labor and an enormous fortress bureaucracy. Maroon banners bear the established angular gold eye insignia: a hostile, sharply narrowed angular eye, slanted menacing upper lid, dark vertical slit pupil, pointed outer corners and short radiating gold points. The eye clearly signals malevolent surveillance, never a friendly or protective charm. This is the same insignia used in the series masthead at the far left, not a new symbol. Worn stone facilities and ordinary office equipment.

F_fod_free_kingdoms.name: Free Peoples and Elven Competitors
F_fod_free_kingdoms.text: Competent and broadly decent elves, humans and other free peoples. Lady Raindew is an established competitor, not a company employee; their architecture and uniforms are distinct.

R_fod_fortress.name: Dark Realm Fortress
R_fod_fortress.text: Medieval-fantasy territory dominated by a huge dark fortress running both corporate offices and war operations. Distinct from the neighboring free elven territories.
